Name: (CP) CL's Haley Portrait Mod
Author: CabbageLeon
Description:
[b][size=4][CP] Cabbage Leon's Haley Portrait Mod[/size][/b]

[size=3]This is a portrait mod that replaces Haley's portraits with my own rendition, complete with all expressions, in HD resolution, and has been play-tested thoroughly.

This mod offers two options; portraits with the pink filter, and portraits without the filter.[/size]

[size=5][b]IMPORTANT﻿[/b]
[size=2][u]THIS MOD REQUIRES, [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/u], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CONTENT PATCHER[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]PORTRAITURE[/url] AND [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url].
[/u][/size][/size]
[u][size=3]How to install and use;[/size][/u][list=1]
[*][size=2]Extract the zip.file in your mod folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]You should see a folder named, " [u][CP] CL's Haley [/u]" (or [[u]CP] CL's Haley Pink Filter[/u] - if that's what you downloaded).[/size]
[*][size=2]You're set![/size]
[size=2]
[u]PORTRAITURE[/u] is an optional mod you can download, but I recommend it if you have multiple portrait mods so you can easily switch between them with the simple press of a button. 

[u]HUGE THANKS FOR THE MODS THAT MADE IT WORK, AND FOR ANY OF YOU THAT WILL USE THIS MOD! :D[/u][/size]
[/list]let me know if there are any issues! this is my very first mod that I've ever worked on. It's been exciting!

Downloads.Description: OPTIONAL: Portraits, but in pink filter.
